predeclared_amendment: The catalog is frozen before A. Visual indexing continues over this same fixed font collection during A and B, which have no access to visual data. Freeze and record the finished visual index before C; do not begin C until coordinator confirms. Model weights and renderer configuration are already fixed. This staging avoids counting setup latency as design time and cannot affect A/B recommendations because their permitted inputs exclude visual data.
